{{Quote|What a desolate place this is.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
The '''Western Dune Sea''', also known as the '''Western Dunes''', was a quadrant of the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. This area was separated from the [[Northern Dune Sea/Legends|Northern Dune Sea]] by the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] and the [[Great Mesra Plateau/Legends|Great Mesra Plateau]].<ref name="ItWoSWT" />

==History==
[[File:Kraytbones.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] near the skeleton of the Western Dune Sea [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] skeleton.]]
{{Quote|But old Ben lives somewhere out on the fringe of the Western Dune Sea. He's kind of a local character.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="ANHnovel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>}}
During the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tatooine]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] of [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] launched from the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] landed in the Western Dune Sea, nearby the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]].<ref name="ItWoSWT" /> The escape pod landed in the eastern limb of the Western Dune Sea, with R2 setting the coordinates 40 kilometers south of its intended target.

While R2-D2 managed to leave the Western Dune Sea to reach the Jundland Wastes, C-3PO was picked up by a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] in the Dune Sea, near the skeleton of a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]].<ref name="ItWoSWT" /> The [[Desert Sands]] unit of [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|desert stormtroopers]] was later tasked to localize the escape pod in the Western Dune Sea and capture its passengers.<ref name="WtDWT:TST">{{StoryCite|story=When the Desert Wind Turns: The Stormtrooper's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>

[[File:Search_for_droids_TCG.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|Sandtroopers]] find the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] that fled the [[Tantive IV/Legends|Tantive IV]].]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]] [[Malakili/Legends|Malakili]] recruited a spacer to get a sample of DNA from the Western Dune Sea krayt dragon skeleton. The skeleton was supposed to belong to an ancient krayt dragon more powerful than any other dragon and Jabba wanted to use the DNA in experiments.<ref name="SWG:SR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Shock Rods|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' incorrectly places Jabba's Palace, the Great Pit of Carkoon and [[Ben Kenobi's home/Legends|Ben Kenobi's hut]] in the Western Dune Sea.<ref name="SWG" />
